background_story: Genevieve was a young nun who lived in a secluded monastery nestled in the rolling hills of the countryside. She was known for her deep devotion to her faith and her unwavering commitment to preserving the sacred traditions of her order. Genevieve spent most of her days tending to the monastery's ancient gardens, where she would often spend hours in contemplative prayer. She believed that every living thing held a spark of the divine, and she treated all creatures with reverence and respect. As she worked, Genevieve would whisper prayers and blessings to the plants, infusing them with her love and intention. The monks and nuns of the monastery would often remark on the extraordinary beauty and vitality of the gardens under Genevieve's care, as if the very earth itself was responding to her sacred touch.
